freePlan.limits: 40-minute meeting limit, 100 participants, 3 AI meeting summaries/month, 20 AI queries/month, 3 whiteboards

keyLimits.en: 40-minute limit per meeting, 100 participants, limited AI features (3 summaries/month, 20 AI queries/month), 3 whiteboards, 5 two-minute clips.
30-hour meeting duration, 100 participants, unlimited meeting summaries, 10GB cloud storage/user, unlimited clips.
300 participants per meeting, unlimited whiteboards and booking pages, admin portal, SSO and managed domains.
1,000+ participants, full PBX phone system, 500-attendee webinars, unlimited cloud recording, end-to-end encryption and customer-managed keys.

cautions.en: The free Basic plan caps group meetings at 40 minutes; teams needing longer calls must upgrade to Pro.
cautions.fr: Le plan gratuit Basic limite les réunions de groupe à 40 minutes ; il faut passer à Pro pour des appels plus longs.

capabilities.en: Video conferencing with cloud recording, AI meeting summaries and AI Companion queries.
Team chat, VoIP calling and collaborative whiteboards bundled into the same workspace.
Short video clip creation and sharing directly from meetings.
Admin portal, SSO and managed domains for organization-wide control on Business and above.

limitations.en: Free plan meetings are capped at 40 minutes, forcing an upgrade for any longer group call.
SSO and managed domains are only available from the Business tier up, not on Pro.
AI Companion usage is capped even on the free plan (3 summaries and 20 queries per month).

reason.en: Direct competitor for video conferencing, bundled differently (within Google Workspace).

missingAlternatives.name: Microsoft Teams
missingAlternatives.reason: Major direct competitor in video conferencing, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: Whether Zoom offers a desktop-specific feature set beyond web/iOS/Android was not confirmed on the pricing page as fetched.
